devices.title: Devices
devices.description: ESPHome devices by address, for those mDNS does not reach. Set up a device in Add accessories to give its encryption key.

host.title: Host
host.description: Host name or IP address, such as my_esp.local or 192.168.1.40

port.title: Port
port.description: The native API's port; 6053 by default

retryAfter.title: Retry after (milliseconds)
retryAfter.description: The longest wait between attempts to reach a device that does not answer, at most one minute; 90000 by default

discover.title: Discover devices
discover.description: Look for ESPHome devices with mDNS at start and connect to each one found

discoveryTimeout.title: Discovery timeout (milliseconds)
discoveryTimeout.description: How long the mDNS search lasts at start; 5000 by default

retryAfter.title: Retry after (milliseconds)
retryAfter.description: The longest wait between attempts to reach a device that does not answer, at most one minute; 90000 by default

blacklist.title: Blacklist
blacklist.description: Entity names to leave out, exactly as ESPHome names them

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Log each device's entities and the ones left out at the info level

host.title: Host
host.description: The device's host name or IP address

port.title: Port
port.description: The native API's port; 6053 by default

retryAfter.description: The longest wait between attempts to reach this device; empty takes the plugin's setting
